name: Frozen ImageNet CNN embeddings
core_design: ResNet50 2048; ConvNeXt-tiny 768; MobileNetV2/EfficientNet-B0 1280; VGG16 GAP 512
validation_or_warning: Not a PM predictor

name: Supervised single-frame CNN
core_design: ImageNet MobileNetV2/EfficientNet-B0/ResNet50 plus scalar head; optional partial unfreezing
validation_or_warning: Random and chronological results differ; random R2 about 0.142

name: IDD YOLO11m traffic detector
core_design: fine-tuned YOLO11m; 15 IDD classes; PM class mapping
validation_or_warning: Original training provenance incomplete

name: IDD SegFormer-B0 road segmenter
core_design: fine-tuned SegFormer-B0 binary road mask
validation_or_warning: Original training provenance incomplete

name: Depth Anything metric road area
core_design: Depth Anything V2 Metric Outdoor Base; pinhole points; triangulated area
validation_or_warning: All rows quality-flagged; generally harmful to PM model

name: AlphaEarth annual embedding
core_design: annual latent A00-A63 embedding
validation_or_warning: Dimensions are latent and not directly interpretable

name: OSM 250m corridor features
core_design: cached Overpass tiles plus local 250m radius filtering
validation_or_warning: Small gains only; static context

name: Classical tabular suite
inputs: sensor; time; YOLO; road; OSM; AlphaEarth
core_design: Ridge; RandomForest; ExtraTrees; HistGradientBoosting
validation_or_warning: Must use grouped-date evaluation for generalization

name: CNN PCA classical sequence
inputs: CNN embeddings; optional flattened T window
core_design: train-only PCA plus Ridge/RF/ET/HGB
validation_or_warning: Best MUMMA-281 row R2 0.425 random 2-fold

name: Single-frame ResNet50 MLP
core_design: LayerNorm; 512; 256; scalar MLP
validation_or_warning: Temporal-free baseline

name: Generic image GRU/LSTM
inputs: T-length CNN embeddings; optional late tabular
core_design: one-layer GRU/LSTM hidden128; final state MLP
validation_or_warning: Random overlap versus whole-date results must be separated

name: HVAQ VGG16-LSTM T7
core_design: one-layer LSTM hidden64; 128 head; log1p target
validation_or_warning: Random R2 0.765; chrono R2 -39.566

name: TRAQID paper CNN-LSTM multitarget
core_design: LSTM final state; dropout MLP; sigmoid min-max outputs
validation_or_warning: Mostly historical random/purged comparisons

name: Early-concat multimodal RNN
inputs: image plus engineered features at every timestep
core_design: project concatenated stream to512; 2-layer GRU/LSTM hidden256
validation_or_warning: Many seed variants; random overlap risk

name: Late CNN-LSTM tabular fusion
core_design: LSTM branch plus two-layer tabular MLP then fusion head
validation_or_warning: Random/twofold/chrono/purged variants must not be mixed

name: Late GRU tabular fusion
core_design: GRU hidden128 plus tabular MLP64 plus fusion128
validation_or_warning: Five grouped-date checkpoints exist

name: Gated dual-branch temporal fusion
core_design: separate recurrent branches; learned sigmoid representation gate
validation_or_warning: Not the same as multi-view lens attention

name: Gated multi-view temporal GRU
core_design: per-lens projections; timestep softmax lens attention; GRU
validation_or_warning: R2 0.958 with 99.27% target/context overlap

name: TRAQID 3-fold OOF clipped residual
core_design: 3 GRUs plus conservative ExtraTrees; residual clip +/-12.5
validation_or_warning: R2 0.966; overlapping random windows

name: Strict image-base residual correction
core_design: actual-base residual; Ridge/ET/RF/HGB correction; origin validation
validation_or_warning: Correction candidate selection must stay inside validation

name: CAMS background local increment
inputs: external CAMS; image or non-PM context
core_design: sPM2 = CAMS background + learned local increment
validation_or_warning: CAMS is external and not target-fitted

name: Nested CAMS temporal-tabular ensemble
inputs: CAMS; lens6 T7 ResNet-GRU; YOLO/road; AlphaEarth; optional OSM
core_design: temporal corrected branch plus tabular ET branch; validation-selected convex weight
validation_or_warning: pooled R2 0.457 but mean date R2 negative; needs untouched dates

name: Weighted greedy and stacked ensembles
core_design: equal/weighted/Dirichlet/greedy blending or Ridge stacking
validation_or_warning: Historical searches risk selection bias; nested MUMMA version is safer

name: Numerical LSTM T12-H12 forecast
core_design: LSTM plus static concatenation; 200-unit head; 24 outputs
validation_or_warning: Uses pollutant history and answers a different task

name: Numerical forecasting baselines
core_design: persistence; Ridge; RF; ExtraTrees
validation_or_warning: Not comparable with current-timestamp non-PM prediction

name: NMF latent source proxy
inputs: 10 PM/OPC channels for inference; non-PM context for prediction
core_design: train-only NMF then multi-output ExtraTrees
validation_or_warning: Components are neutral factors not chemical sources

name: Assumed-profile Monte Carlo NNLS
inputs: four incremental mass bins; illustrative profiles; non-PM context
core_design: Dirichlet profile draws; NNLS; ExtraTrees context prediction
validation_or_warning: Degenerate dominant solution; not measured attribution

name: Direct particle-regime models
targets: mass fractions; diameter; density proxy; number proxy
core_design: ExtraTrees composition and scalar models; train-only PCA optional
validation_or_warning: Density/number units still provisional
